layman_headline: All three positions are green — ride the wave but keep your hand on the exit.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just blew past $77,000 in its best week since 2023, and it's dragging the whole market up with it. Our three open trades — Ethereum, Solana, and Hyperliquid — are all profitable, gaining between 3% and 5%. The market mood has swung sharply from cautious to greedy in just one week, which is great for current positions but makes chasing new entries risky right now.
layman_action: Hold all three current positions and let them run toward their profit targets. Don't add new positions right now — the market has moved too fast too quickly, and a pullback is likely before the next good entry appears.
expert_reasoning: All three holdings are performing well in a strongly trending market. BTC +22.3% on the week with Fear & Greed jumping from 45.7 weekly avg to 72 signals a momentum regime shift. However, this rapid sentiment improvement (from neutral to greed in days) historically precedes short-term consolidation. Every swing candidate on the watchlist has already moved 20-67% in 7 days — there are no fresh setups with favorable risk/reward. ETH at +5.3% is approaching its $2,520 target with strong ETF inflow catalysts (CoinTelegraph reports $608M). HYPE has a CryptoSlate catalyst regarding potential US regulatory approval for onshore operations, which is a reliable signal source per our track record. The prudent move is to hold all three and wait for a pullback to deploy remaining capital.
risk_factors: Weekend liquidity thinning could cause sharp reversals — CoinDesk notes Bitcoin faces the $80K test with reduced weekend volume
Fear & Greed at 72 after jumping from ~46 weekly average signals potential overheating and profit-taking risk
BTC dominance at 59.9% is high, meaning alt positions could underperform if capital rotates back to BTC
watch_list: Bitcoin's attempt at $80,000 over the weekend — a rejection could trigger a pullback across all alts
ETH approaching $2,520 exit target — prepare to take profits if momentum stalls near resistance
Hyperliquid regulatory news development — CryptoSlate reports US onshore approval signals could be a major catalyst
market_context: Bitcoin is having its best week since 2023, surging 22% and destroying $4B in shorts. The entire market is in a broad rally with sentiment shifting rapidly from fear to greed, but weekend liquidity risks loom.
context_banner: Strong uptrend with all positions profitable — hold and manage exits rather than chase extended entries in an overheated short-term market.

key_signals.description: Bitcoin ETFs drew $608M in inflows while Ether ETFs saw their largest inflow since October, confirming institutional demand supporting our ETH position.
US regulatory rule rewrite looming for Hyperliquid with Trump signaling onshore approval — a reliable news source (67% win rate) supporting our HYPE hold.
Fear & Greed jumped from 45.7 weekly average to 72 (Greed) — rapid sentiment improvement supports holding current positions but warns against new entries.
BTC volume at $67.5B with $4B short liquidations indicates genuine momentum rather than low-conviction drift — supports holding alt positions.
Among swing candidates, only MON (RSI 41) shows non-overbought conditions, but its 34% weekly move and position below SMA20 make it unattractive for entry.
